atomic_transaction_contract.idempotency_scope: unique actor + operation type + caller operation_id
atomic_transaction_contract.same_id_same_hash: return the original durable semantic result or stable error
atomic_transaction_contract.response_loss: retry reads the committed operation result and never duplicates content, IAM, event, audit, or outbox effects

permission_epoch_contract.stale_epoch_result: deny or drop with zero protected payload and no existence oracle

revoke_delivery_fence_contract.gateway_wakeup: best-effort immediate signal backed by the durable outbox; it may close stale physical connections but is not the authorization authority
revoke_delivery_fence_contract.before_every_protected_send: read the current canonical epochs and compare them with the frame, connection, subject, workspace, and page binding immediately before the network write; cached allow state is insufficient
revoke_delivery_fence_contract.queued_old_epoch_frame: drop without protected payload and without advancing an authorized delivery cursor
revoke_delivery_fence_contract.authority_check_unavailable: fail closed by dropping the frame or closing the subscription; never send and never acknowledge authorization
revoke_delivery_fence_contract.inbound_command_ack: emit only after durable command acceptance and commit-time epoch revalidation
revoke_delivery_fence_contract.delivery_cursor_ack: accept only for an already authorized durable sequence at the current epoch; stale ACK never advances replay state

gateway_unavailable_response.safety: the unavailable gateway sends nothing; after restart every send checks the canonical epoch before writing

revoke_delivery_fence_contract.completion_point: the deny state and fence event are committed and the globally enforced send-time check makes every old-epoch delivery impossible; an active-connection ACK is not required by the selected strategy

legacy_cutover_contract.allowed_sources: sanitized deterministic copies under a marker-bound disposable root
legacy_cutover_contract.pre_cutover_legacy_role: authoritative only while successor flags are disabled
legacy_cutover_contract.cutover: stop legacy mutation, verify the frozen import high-water and hashes, import once, atomically enable the dev-only resolver, then keep legacy shards immutable
legacy_cutover_contract.post_cutover_legacy_role: immutable evidence or generated compatibility projection
legacy_cutover_contract.rollback_before_first_candidate_write: disable candidate reads/writes and return to the unchanged legacy authority
legacy_cutover_contract.rollback_after_first_candidate_write: roll forward or restore the candidate authority; never replay legacy data over newer candidate state

second_brain_boundary.approval_behavior: publish the exact previewed revision or fail stale; cancel creates no SBE item or revision
ordered_publication_contract: resolve one exact committed Notion revision, hash, and epochs
revalidate current Notion source authorization and publication eligibility
call the SBE service layer with caller operation_id and canonical request hash
revalidate target SBE native-space authority at SBE commit time
commit SBE item/revision, audit, and outbox in the SBE transaction
return or replay the original result for the same operation_id and hash
second_brain_boundary.later_notion_revoke_effect: blocks unpublished preview, new publication, and live Notion attachment access; it does not hide, deactivate, delete, or rewrite an independently committed SBE item

prototype_boundary.a0b_p1_obligation: re-read the current schema lineage and cross-stream ownership, then allocate the next forward migration and prove deterministic import/cutover
